path.aria-label: Control plane, Linux memory path and independent production pressure-monitor service
Page faults fetch data back on demand.
Marks aged idle entries, then writes
Logical swap distinct from RAM usage.
Full page slot per eligible page.
READBACK WORKER / oldest allocation first · parallel pages within each block
Controller never writes idle/writeback sysfs interfaces. Only the pressure service does. Cold allocation charges 3 logical slots / up to 2 backing slots per triplet.
